The core innovation lies in leveraging Apache Flink’s event-time processing model to manage asynchronous, unordered data streams typical in real-time sports environments. Watermark generation ensures bounded out-of-order arrival while maintaining semantic correctness. Keyed state allows for per-player and per-possession computations without global coordination overhead. These primitives support a dualism between deterministic computation and probabilistic inference—where event-time semantics underpin GSI’s Bayesian updating framework, and keyed aggregations form the basis of GSE’s tactical reasoning engine. Failure modes include clock skew affecting watermark validity, and stale state leading to incorrect KPIs. Latency reduction stems from avoiding batch boundaries and enabling micro-batching at scale. The system's robustness hinges on exactly-once guarantees via checkpointing and idempotent producers.
